code: set.seed(5) n <- 1500 region <- sample(c("US", "MN", "DE"), n, TRUE, prob = c(0.5, 0.3, 0.2)) box <- list(US = c(-112, -104, 38, 46), MN = c(98, 110, 43, 47), DE = c(7, 13, 49, 52)) b <- t(sapply(region, function(r) box[[r]])) min_ma <- round(runif(n, 23, 60), 1) fos <- data.frame(   occurrence_no = seq_len(n),   accepted_name = sample(c("Hyracotherium", "Coryphodon", "Mesonyx", "Uintatherium", "Andrewsarchus"), n, TRUE),   lng = round(runif(n, b[, 1], b[, 2]), 3),   lat = round(runif(n, b[, 3], b[, 4]), 3),   cc = region,   min_ma = min_ma,   max_ma = min_ma + round(runif(n, 1, 12), 1),   truth = "clean") put <- function(i, truth, ...) {   v <- list(...)   for (nm in names(v)) fos[i, nm] <<- v[[nm]]   fos$truth[i] <<- truth } i <- sample(n, 140) put(i[1:20], "centroid", lng = rep(c(-112.4962, 103.0563, 10.3815), length.out = 20),     lat = rep(c(45.6881, 46.8258, 51.1064), length.out = 20), cc = rep(c("US", "MN", "DE"), length.out = 20)) put(i[21:35], "museum", lng = rep(c(8.6517, -0.1764), length.out = 15),     lat = rep(c(50.1175, 51.4958), length.out = 15)) put(i[36:45], "zero", lng = 0, lat = 0) put(i[46:70], "age_copied", max_ma = fos$min_ma[i[46:70]]) put(i[71:90], "age_swapped", min_ma = fos$max_ma[i[71:90]], max_ma = fos$min_ma[i[71:90]]) put(i[91:130], "age_period", min_ma = 23, max_ma = sample(c(66, 145), 40, TRUE)) put(i[131:140], "centroid_near", lng = -112.4962, lat = 45.6881 + 0.027, cc = "US") table(fos$truth) #>  #>    age_copied    age_period   age_swapped      centroid centroid_near  #>            25            40            20            20            10  #>         clean        museum          zero  #>          1360            15            10
